name: Code Friendly Extraction
description: Fast single-step extraction into a strict parseable text format.

steps.name: Structured extraction
steps.system_prompt: You are a materials science data assistant. Extract material samples and their attributes into a strict machine-parseable format.
steps.user_prompt_template:
Identify each distinct material sample or system. Use this exact format:
# SAMPLE: <Sample Name>
- <Property Name> | <Value> | <Unit> | <Remark/Condition> | <Source> | <Method>
Use N/A for unavailable units. Keep one property per line.

Text:
{document_text}
